import pathlib
for file in sorted(pathlib.Path('notebooks').iterdir()):
    if file.suffix == '.qmd' and pathlib.Path(f'docs/notebooks/{file.stem}.html').exists():
        print(f"- [{file.stem}](/notebooks/{file.stem}.html)")
